subject: keyboard walk mode
outcome: WASD or arrow keys enable an interpretive walk; pointer lock is optional, drag look is supported without pointer lock, and a visible exit control and Escape release walk state. Static wall and column collision constraints prevent major penetrations.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Support sensible spawn points, interiors, thresholds and collision-aware movement
Test mouse/keyboard control release, floor height and reentry behavior
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: Collision geometry is simplified and is not appropriate for conservation or accessibility-route certification.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
